mapper.select: select a.FINPROD_ID as finprodId ,c.TYPE_9 as bondOneType,c.TYPE_10 as bondTwoType,e.CUSTOMER_NAME as publisher ,f.CUSTOMER_NAME as manager,a.TRADE_MARKET as tradingPlace, b.BOARD ,d.REP_INDUSTRY as repIndustry from FIN_PRODUCT a LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD b on a.FINPROD_ID=b.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE c on a.FINPROD_ID=c.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN REP_ASSET_EQUITY d on a.FINPROD_ID=d.REP_FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO e on a.ISSUER=e.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO f on a.MANAGER=f.CUSTOMER_ID where a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID= #{finprodId} LIMIT 1
select T.FINPROD_ID as finprodId,T.ISSUER as publisher,T.MANAGER as manager from FIN_PRODUCT T where T.FINPROD_MARKET_ID= #{finprodId} LIMIT 1
